source: Journey OS Production Bible §09 — ECD Task Model (G02)

shells.name: Diagnosis from Presentation
shells.template_structure: A {patient_age}-year-old {patient_sex} presents with {chief_complaint} for {duration}. {key_findings}. {labs_imaging}. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

shells.name: Diagnosis from Laboratory Pattern
shells.template_structure: A {patient_age}-year-old {patient_sex} presents with {symptoms}. Laboratory evaluation reveals {lab_panel} with {abnormal_values}. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

shells.name: Diagnosis from Imaging Description
shells.template_structure: {presenting_context}. {imaging_modality} reveals {imaging_findings}. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

shells.name: Drug Mechanism of Action
shells.template_structure: {clinical_scenario}. {drug_name} is initiated. Which of the following best describes its primary mechanism of action?

shells.name: Pathophysiological Mechanism
shells.template_structure: {patient_demographics} with {condition_context}. {specific_finding}. Which of the following best explains the pathophysiological mechanism responsible for this finding?

shells.name: Anatomical Mechanism / Structural Basis
shells.template_structure: {clinical_scenario}. {anatomical_finding}. Which of the following structures is most likely responsible?

shells.name: Next Best Diagnostic Step
shells.template_structure: {patient_demographics} presents with {presentation}. {initial_evaluation}. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in the evaluation?

shells.name: Next Best Management Step
shells.template_structure: {patient_demographics} is diagnosed with {diagnosis_established}. {current_status}. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

shells.name: Emergency Immediate Action
shells.template_structure: {emergent_scenario}. Vital signs: {vital_signs}. Examination reveals {physical_findings}. Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate action?

shells.name: Biomarker / Laboratory Test Selection
shells.template_structure: {clinical_scenario}. {timing_context}. Which of the following laboratory tests is most appropriate to {clinical_question}?

shells.name: Drug Selection by Indication / Patient Profile
shells.template_structure: {patient_profile} with {diagnosis}. {contraindication_context}. Which of the following is the most appropriate pharmacotherapy?

shells.name: Screening Test Recommendation
shells.template_structure: {patient_demographics} presents for a routine health maintenance visit. {risk_factors}. According to current guidelines, which of the following screening tests is most appropriate?
